tldr: The Moon in Libra: emotions seek harmony, reciprocity, and relational balance.
body: With the Moon in Libra, feelings are shaped by atmosphere, fairness, and the quality of connection. Emotional safety grows when relationships feel mutual instead of performative.
gift: Diplomacy, grace, emotional fairness, and the ability to soothe conflict without losing nuance.
challenge: People-pleasing, avoidance, and swallowing needs to preserve peace.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
